About this item

  • Fifty-Two Times Optical Zoom for Extraordinary Reach Beyond Any Other Camera in Its Class: Reach subjects that most cameras simply cannot with fifty two times optical zoom and a twenty four mm wide angle lens that captures everything from sweeping wide-angle landscapes to tight telephoto close-ups of birds, wildlife, and athletes—bringing distant action into frame with genuine optical sharpness rather than degraded digital zoom
  • Six Frames Per Second Burst Mode to Capture the Decisive Moment: Never miss peak action with six frames per second burst shooting that captures rapid sequences of wildlife movement, sports action, and fast-paced events; review each burst on the three inch LCD and select the sharpest frame for consistently better keepers when subjects are unpredictable, moving quickly, or the moment happens in a fraction of a second
  • Sixteen Megapixel BSI CMOS Sensor with Optical Image Stabilization at Every Zoom Level: Backside-illuminated sensor technology delivers sharp, detailed images with better low-light performance, while built-in OIS actively compensates for hand movement even at maximum fifty two times zoom reach—so handheld telephoto shots come out crisp and clear without requiring a tripod in the field
  • Built-in Wi-Fi for Wireless Control and Instant Social Sharing Straight from the Field: Connect the AZ528 to your smartphone or tablet to wirelessly transfer photos and post to social media immediately after every great shot; use your phone as a live remote viewfinder for hands-free shooting from a distance; full one thousand eighty p HD video records smooth wildlife sequences, travel adventures, and event coverage
  • Rechargeable Li-Ion Battery and Generous Memory Support for Full-Day Shooting Sessions: A rechargeable lithium-ion battery powers extended shooting sessions in the field, and the camera accepts Class ten SD, SDHC, or SDXC memory cards up to five hundred twelve GB—enough storage for thousands of high-resolution photos and hours of Full HD video from a full day of wildlife photography, travel, or sports

Product Description

The Kodak PIXPRO AZ528 represents the pinnacle of the Astro Zoom collection, combining fifty two times optical zoom with six frames per second burst shooting for photographers who demand both extraordinary reach and decisive speed. A sixteen megapixel BSI CMOS sensor paired with optical image stabilization delivers sharp, detailed images even at extreme telephoto distances, while burst mode ensures you capture the decisive frame when subjects move unpredictably or fast.

Built-in Wi-Fi connects to your smartphone via the free app for wireless photo transfer, remote live-view control, and immediate social sharing straight from the field. Full one thousand eighty p HD video records wildlife sequences, travel adventures, and event coverage in smooth, clear detail. A rechargeable lithium-ion battery powers extended sessions, and the camera accepts Class ten SD, SDHC, or SDXC memory cards up to five hundred twelve GB. Whether photographing birds in flight, athletes in competition, or landscapes across a canyon, the AZ528 gives you the reach and speed to capture what others simply miss.

From the manufacturer

360° Panorama Feature

TAKE IT ALL IN - You have been planning the trip of a lifetime. What better way to share those once in a lifetime sunsets with friends and family than to use the full spectrum 360° Panorama mode. Just sweep the AZ528 across your subject and let this powerful camera do the rest.

Key Features

52x Optical Zoom

GET IN CLOSE - There's no need to be in the thick of the action with this powerful mega-zoom lens. 52x optical zoom ensures you get right up close with all the clarity and detail of being right there. Center stage, orchestra or balcony level, every seat is the best seat in the house.

16 Megapixels

FILL IN THE DETAILS - Crisp, clean quality is what you’ll get with the details from 16 million pixels. Add a cutting-edge CMOS sensor and you've got the superb value with 6fps burst shooting, High Dynamic Range (HDR), and plenty of other features that make your storytelling reach new heights.

WiFi Connectivity

STAY CONNECTED - Don’t let anyone miss out on the action! The KODAK PIXPRO AZ528 Astro Zoom bridge camera can easily connect wirelessly to your smart device to you can upload and share your best shots with friends, family and the world while on the go. Now that makes life easier, doesn't it?

1080p Full HD Video

LIFE IN MOTION - Let's face it, life doesn't stand still and neither should you or your camera. The AZ528 makes it easier than ever to switch from clear beautiful photos to Full 1080p HD video with just the touch of a button. No toggling of dials, settings or missing that special moment in motion.

24mm Wide Angle Lens

ROOM FOR EVERYONE - Sure, we take photos every day when we're on the go and it's quantity versus quality. But for those special occasions, the moments you want to capture forever and include the entire family, this is the lens you want to use.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
